title: Star-Lance Contest: War Memory
description: Star-Lance Contest unfolds across star-lance colonnade where spear-light divides safe lanes from glory traps, pushing a 5-Titan Olympian squad to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Star-Lance Contest: War Memory advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
